questions_and_answers.question: Student A asks 'Doko de nan-ji ni aimashoo ka?' (Where and at what time shall we meet?) Referring to the list, Student B is to meet at a coffee shop at three o'clock. How does Student B answer?

answers.answer: Kissaten de san-ji ni aimashoo.
Kissaten de go-ji han ni aimashoo.
Mitsukoshi no mae de san-ji ni aimashoo.
Hon-ya de yo-ji han ni aimashoo.

questions_and_answers.question: Student B is to meet in front of Mitsukoshi at five thirty. How does Student B answer?

answers.answer: Mitsukoshi no mae de go-ji han ni aimashoo.
Mitsukoshi no mae de san-ji ni aimashoo.
Kissaten de go-ji han ni aimashoo.
Amerika Ryoojikan de ni-ji ni aimashoo.

questions_and_answers.question: Student B is to meet at the American Consulate at two o'clock. How does Student B answer?

answers.answer: Amerika Ryoojikan de ni-ji ni aimashoo.
Amerika Ryoojikan de yo-ji han ni aimashoo.
Hon-ya de ni-ji ni aimashoo.
Amerika Taishikan no mae de roku-ji ni aimashoo.

questions_and_answers.question: Student B is to meet at a bookstore at four thirty. How does Student B answer?

answers.answer: Hon-ya de yo-ji han ni aimashoo.
Hon-ya de san-ji ni aimashoo.
Kissaten de yo-ji han ni aimashoo.
Mitsukoshi no mae de go-ji han ni aimashoo.

questions_and_answers.question: Student B is to meet in front of the U.S. Embassy at six o'clock. How does Student B answer?

answers.answer: Amerika Taishikan no mae de roku-ji ni aimashoo.
Amerika Taishikan no mae de ni-ji ni aimashoo.
Amerika Ryoojikan no mae de roku-ji ni aimashoo.
Hon-ya no mae de roku-ji ni aimashoo.

articles.text: Directions: Student A asks where and at what time s/he and student B are to meet. Student B answers, referring to the list below.

Example: Student A: Doko de nan-ji ni aimashoo ka? Student B: Depaato no mae de san-ji ni aimashoo. List for Student B (place / time): coffee shop / three o'clock; in front of Mitsukoshi / five thirty; American Consulate / two o'clock; bookstore / four thirty; in front of U.S. Embassy / six o'clock.
